name: zdi_add_polygon
description: zDi::AddPolygon forwards its public polygon arguments to zDi::AddPolygonEx while inserting a null entry-normal argument.
known_limits: Functional acceptance covers the wrapper forwarding contract. tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zModel AddPolygon/AddPolygonEx source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x483610 validates the fastcall wrapper ABI with self in ecx and pointCount in edx, forwards the nine stack arguments unchanged, pushes a null entry-normal argument, calls zDi::AddPolygonEx at 0x483650, and returns with callee stack cleanup.

The native smoke verifies that the production zDi::AddPolygon wrapper reaches the AddPolygonEx direct-add path, preserves draw flags and caller tag bytes, does not allocate entry normal indices, interns vertices/blend normals, and rebuilds normalized UVs.
